title: NyaySutra AI
tagline: Agentic RAG legal-research assistant for Indian advocates (team project with Suraj Madane)
description: A secure, explainable legal-research assistant: agentic RAG over official bare acts and your own case files, where every answer is cited and every citation is checked against the source text.
points: Hybrid retrieval: exact section lookup + BM25 + dense embeddings, fused and reranked; 31 indexed bare acts.
Citation-audited answers on the project benchmark raised from 40% to 74% (31 of 42).
Reads 21 file types, including scanned Hindi/Marathi papers via built-in OCR; drafting studio with 22 templates.
Supabase Postgres with row-level security, TOTP two-step sign-in, AI guardrails and an audit log; 131 offline tests.

title: LUMINA: AI DevOps Troubleshooter
description: An agentic AI system for DevOps, cloud and software errors. A LangGraph pipeline classifies the error, researches current sources with Tavily, drafts a fix with Gemini, and a reviewer step sends weak drafts back for more research.
points: LangGraph state machine: Classifier → Researcher → Coder → Reviewer → Router, with a feedback loop.
Web grounding with Tavily; Streamlit interface.
Upgrade in review on the phase branches: package structure, tests with fake LLM/search, Docker, CI and a 50-case hand-labelled benchmark with rule-based scoring.

title: CodeSynapse: AI Career Architect
tagline: AI-powered career analytics dashboard for CS students
description: Pulls live GitHub and LeetCode stats into one dashboard with a Gemini career coach, plus a LangGraph skill-gap agent that compares a repository with a job description and cites the exact lines that prove each skill. The live demo still runs the earlier January 2026 version.
points: Skill-gap agent (plan → retrieve → assess → verify → recommend) with a deterministic verifier: every claim must quote real code at the cited lines.
Hard benchmark: F1 0.91 vs 0.77 for a single-prompt baseline; all 72 cited code lines verified; 8 of 8 prompt-injection attacks blocked.
Hybrid code search (Tree-sitter, BM25, pgvector), FastAPI REST API, tests and CI against Postgres with a Docker build.

title: Peheraav AI: Your Wardrobe, Styled by AI
tagline: Live full-stack app that builds outfits only from clothes you own
description: Add photos of your own clothes once, then ask in English or Hinglish, by typing or voice. Peheraav builds up to 4 complete outfits from pieces you really own, explains why each one works, and says so honestly when something is missing. Live on Azure with personal accounts.
points: Rule-based styling engine that never invents a piece you do not own.
Outfit boards from your own photos, with backgrounds removed in the browser (IS-Net + SegFormer on ONNX Runtime Web).
Wedding, festival and trip planners; weather-aware suggestions; wear stats, cost per wear and Shop Smart ideas; optional style profile.
Accounts with email confirmation and password reset; Azure + Caddy https; nightly off-site backups; 258 automated backend tests.

title: TrendPulse
description: An end-to-end analytics demo on synthetic data: generates sales and social posts, scores sentiment with TextBlob, stores everything in SQLite and serves it through a Streamlit app and a Power BI dashboard.
points: SQLAlchemy + Pandas pipeline that scores post sentiment with TextBlob.
Streamlit dashboard with platform filters, revenue trajectory and a sentiment deep-dive.
The same data exported to a Power BI report.

title: Stock Anomaly Detector
tagline: Rolling 20-day Z-score anomaly detection on daily prices
description: A Streamlit dashboard that fetches two years of daily prices from Yahoo Finance, flags closes more than three standard deviations from the 20-day rolling mean, and keeps a SQLite history of anomalies. Packaged with Docker and deployed on Render.
points: 20-day sliding-window Z-score detection (|Z| > 3).
Anomalies stored once each in SQLite and shown as a history table.
Docker image deployed on Render.

title: SENTINEL: Urban Conflict Resolver
description: An AI dashboard that detects when city departments (water, electricity, transport, telecom) plan to use the same space at the same time, scores each conflict, predicts new ones before approval and suggests how to resolve them.
points: Conflict detection using time and geospatial overlap, with a severity score.
Random Forest model predicts whether a new request will conflict before it is approved.
Conflict network graph (NetworkX) and map view, plus reschedule / relocate suggestions.

title: EduFlow ERP
description: A prototype in progress that automates internship applications and NOC/LOR approvals through a structured chain: Class Teacher → HOD → TnP Head → IIIC Director, with analytics dashboards on top of the approved data. Uses dummy data only.
points: Role-based student and faculty portals for applying, approving and reporting outcomes.
SQL analytics views feeding KPI dashboards, with export for Power BI / Tableau.
Exploring an n8n agent workflow for request handling and process automation.

title: KavachAI
tagline: Behaviour-based detection of fake calls from known contacts
description: Built for the Srijan Hackathon. A privacy-first prototype that judges whether a call from a known contact looks genuine using calling behaviour (time, duration, frequency, origin), not caller ID, with everything running locally. Trained on synthetic data.
points: Isolation Forest model trained on call time, duration, frequency and origin.
Local SQLite vault stores trusted-contact baselines; no call data leaves the device.
Flet dashboard shows Verified / Alert / Unknown with an explanation for each alert.

title: Project Drishti
description: A UIDAI Hackathon analysis of about 4.9 million aggregated Aadhaar enrolment and update records that surfaces operational bottlenecks, regional hotspots and compliance gaps, with recommendations for resource allocation.
points: Spatiotemporal anomaly detection across enrolment and update records.
Identified weekday load spikes and high-load pincodes, with suggested interventions.
Visual intelligence gallery of donut charts, treemaps and compliance rankings.

title: Stakeholder Insights Dashboard
tagline: Tableau dashboard for premium, profitability and policy performance
description: An interactive Tableau dashboard giving stakeholders and insurers a single source of truth for premium trends, profitability, shareholding and assets under management.
points: KPIs for total premium, value created and top-performing insurer.
Filters by city, stakeholder, policy tenure and date range.

title: Road Accident Analysis
tagline: Interactive Excel dashboard for 2021–2022 accident trends
description: A dynamic Excel dashboard that analyses road accident trends across 2021 and 2022, with slicers to compare rural and urban areas and spot high-risk periods.
points: Pivot tables, slicers and advanced charting, built entirely in Excel.
Kaggle demo dataset, structured around specific road-safety business questions.

title: Coffee Shop Sales EDA
tagline: Exploratory data analysis of 9,971 transactions in R
description: Turns 9,971 coffee-shop transactions (5 US cities, 2021–2023) into findings on seasonality, city profitability, product mix, pricing and outliers.
points: January is the clear revenue peak and February the lowest; Chicago leads total profit margin, Seattle trails.
Revenue spread evenly across 7 product categories; a few very large transactions in Austin and Chicago flagged for checking.
Data preparation and plots in R with dplyr, ggplot2 and lubridate.

title: Secure Tool
tagline: Encryption & decryption app with a Tkinter GUI
description: A Python desktop application for encoding and decoding messages with a custom key, with user accounts, passkey strength checks and an action history.
points: Account-based login, custom-key encoding and passkey strength analysis.
History of encryption and decryption actions.
